candidateAudit.text: AMS Başkanı’ndan emeklilik yaşı çıkışı: “Matematik ideolojiyi yener” Avusturya İş Piyasası Kurumu AMS Başkanı Johannes Kopf, ülkede emeklilik yaşının yükseltilmesi gerektiğini bir kez daha gündeme getirdi. Kopf, ORF’de katıldığı “Pressestunde” programında, demografik gelişmeler nedeniyle emeklilik sistemi konusunda uzun vadeli kararlar alınması gerektiğini belirterek, “Bir noktada matematik ideolojiyi yener” dedi. Kopf, siyasetin yalnızca toplumda popüler olan kararları değil, gerekli gördüğü adımları da atması gerektiğini savundu. “Göç istemeyen daha uzun çalışmalı” Avusturya’da yaşlanan nüfusa da dikkat çeken Kopf, göçe karşı çıkanlara yönelik dikkat çekici bir ifade kullandı: “Avusturya’da yabancı istemiyorum diyenler, o zaman kendileri daha uzun çalışmak zorunda.” Kopf’a göre emeklilik yaşının yükseltilmesi konusunun siyasette yeterince tartışılmamasının nedenlerinden biri de seçmenlerin yaş yapısı. Ortalama seçmen yaşının 50’nin üzerinde olduğunu belirten Kopf, bu yaşlardan itibaren insanların kendi emekliliklerini daha fazla düşünmeye başladığını söyledi. Kadınların emeklilik yaşını örnek gösterdi Avusturya’da kadınların emeklilik yaşının kademeli olarak 60’tan 65’e yükseltilmesi sürecinin devam ettiğini hatırlatan Kopf, bu uygulamanın 2033 yılına kadar tamamlanacağını belirtti. Kopf’un verdiği rakamlara göre değişiklik sonucunda 60 yaş üzerindeki kadınlarda işsiz sayısı yaklaşık 7.500 kişi arttı, ancak aynı yaş grubunda çalışanların sayısı 58 bin yükseldi. 60 yaş üzerindeki çalışanlara dikkat çekti AMS Başkanı, şirketlerin yaşlı çalışanlara yaklaşımını da eleştirdi.

candidateAudit.title: Die berühmte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe Manche Gerichte sind mehr als nur eine Speise, sie erzählen Geschichten von Familie, Tradition und einem besonderen Geschmack, den man ei
candidateAudit.text: Die berühmte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe Manche Gerichte sind mehr als nur eine Speise, sie erzählen Geschichten von Familie, Tradition und einem besonderen Geschmack, den man ein Leben lang nicht vergisst. Im Oktober hat bei uns wieder ein besonderes Familienrezept seinen großen Auftritt: die Original Böhmische Fischsuppe. Seit vielen Jahren gehört sie im Schweizerhaus zur herbstlichen Schmankerlkarte und das aus gutem Grund. Ursprünglich wurde diese traditionelle Fischsuppe, deren Hauptdarsteller der Karpfen ist, von Oma Kolarik zu Weihnachten für die Familie zubereitet. Heute holen wir die Lieblingssuppe unseres Chefs bereits im Herbst aus dem Familienrezeptbuch und servieren sie im Oktober auf unserer wöchentlichen Schmankerlkarte. Für ihren unverwechselbaren Geschmack und ihre feine, sämige Konsistenz sorgen unter anderem Karpfenmilch und Karpfenrogen. Sie verleihen der Suppe ihre natürliche Bindung und machen sie zu einem besonderen Genuss. Der feine Fischgeschmack kommt dabei ganz ohne künstliche Geschmacksverstärker aus. Zum Schluss geben ein Schuss Rotwein und etwas Zitronensaft der Suppe den perfekten Feinschliff. Wer die hausgemachte Original Böhmische Fischsuppe nach dem traditionellen Familienrezept kennenlernen möchte, sollte uns im Oktober unbedingt noch besuchen. Ob im herbstlich goldenen Gastgarten oder, wenn es draußen etwas kühler wird, in unseren gemütlichen Innenbereichen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Ihnen ein Stück unserer Familiengeschichte servieren zu dürfen.

candidateAudit.title: Today is Coming Out Day. We celebrate everyone who has come out, whether once or a hundred times. We also make room for everyone who can't, won't, or isn't ready yet. For many tran
candidateAudit.text: Today is Coming Out Day. We celebrate everyone who has come out, whether once or a hundred times. We also make room for everyone who can't, won't, or isn't ready yet. For many trans people, BIPOC queers, and folks without secure papers or family support, being visible can cost a lot. Nobody owes the world a coming out. That's why spaces like Villa Vida matter. Since 2019 we've been a living room for Vienna's queer community, a place where you don't have to explain yourself. Out, not out, still figuring it out: you belong here. Heute ist Coming Out Day. Wir feiern alle, die sich geoutet haben, ob einmal oder hundertmal. Und wir halten Platz für alle, die es nicht können, nicht wollen oder noch nicht so weit sind. Für viele trans Personen, BIPOC-Queers und Menschen ohne sicheren Aufenthalt oder Rückhalt in der Familie kann Sichtbarkeit viel kosten. Niemand schuldet der Welt ein Coming-out. Genau deshalb braucht es Orte wie die Villa Vida. Seit 2019 sind wir ein Wohnzimmer für die queere Community in Wien, ein Ort, an dem du dich nicht erklären musst. Out, nicht out oder noch am Herausfinden: Du gehörst dazu. 📍 Linke Wienzeile 102, Wien · Main entrance / Haupteingang: Spörlingasse 1 villavidacafe #VillaVida #ComingOutDay #QueerWien #QueerVienna #LGBTQIA

candidateAudit.text: ‼️Salzburg Havalimanı 100 sezonluk çalışan arıyor Salzburg Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Havalimanı, yaklaşan kış sezonu için farklı alanlarda çalıştırılmak üzere yaklaşık 100 ek personel arıyor. İşe alınacak çalışanların kasım ayının ortasından mart ayının sonuna kadar süreli olarak görev yapması planlanıyor. Personel ihtiyacının özellikle yoğun kış turizmi nedeniyle arttığı belirtiliyor. Havalimanında açık pozisyonlar arasında uçak yer hizmetleri, bagaj ayrıştırma, yolcu hizmetleri, apron çalışmaları, temizlik, yolculara yönelik sağlık hizmetleri ve teknik görevler bulunuyor. Yoğun günlerde 26 bin yolcu Salzburg Havalimanı kış sezonunda özellikle kayak turizmi nedeniyle oldukça yoğun çalışıyor. En yoğun günlerde havalimanında 170 uçak iniş ve kalkış yaparken, yolcu sayısı 26 bine kadar çıkabiliyor. Yolcuların önemli bölümü İngiltere, İrlanda, İsrail ve Almanya’dan geliyor. Almanya’daki havalimanları üzerinden de farklı ülkelerden Salzburg’a turistler ulaşıyor. Geçtiğimiz kış sezonunda Salzburg Havalimanı personel ihtiyacının bir bölümünü Almanya’dan karşılamıştı. Nürnberg Havalimanı’ndan yaklaşık 20 sezonluk çalışan, özellikle check-in ve yolcu hizmetlerinde Salzburg’daki ekiplere destek vermişti.

candidateAudit.title: Avusturya’da evini yenileyene devlet desteği: 5.000 Euro’ya kadar teşvik Avusturya hükümeti, konutların yenilenmesi ve eski ısıtma sistemlerinin değiştirilmesi için 500 milyon Euro
candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da evini yenileyene devlet desteği: 5.000 Euro’ya kadar teşvik Avusturya hükümeti, konutların yenilenmesi ve eski ısıtma sistemlerinin değiştirilmesi için 500 milyon Euro’luk yeni bir teşvik programı açıkladı. Yeni desteklerden bazıları Kasım 2026’da, kapsamlı termal yenileme destekleri ise Ocak 2027’de başlayacak. Program kapsamında evini enerji açısından daha verimli hale getirenler, pencerelerini değiştirenler veya eski petrol ve gazlı ısıtma sistemlerini yenileyenler devletten maddi destek alabilecek. Yeni pencerelere 4.000 Euro’ya kadar 2027’den itibaren eski pencerelerini enerji tasarruflu modellerle değiştiren ev sahipleri, yenileme kapsamında 4.000 Euro’ya kadar destek alabilecek. Aynı zamanda dış cephe güneş koruması, örneğin panjur veya dış jaluzi yaptırılması halinde 1.000 Euro daha verilebilecek. Böylece toplam federal destek 5.000 Euro’ya kadar çıkabilecek. Ancak devlet, teşvik kapsamına giren yatırım maliyetinin en fazla yüzde 30’unu karşılayacak. Eski ısıtma sistemleri için de destek Petrol veya gazla çalışan eski ısıtma sistemlerini çevre dostu sistemlerle değiştirmek isteyenler de programdan yararlanabilecek. Müstakil bir evin yenilenebilir enerji kullanan bölgesel ısıtma sistemine bağlanması halinde 4.000 Euro’ya kadar destek öngörülüyor. Eski petrol ve gazlı ısıtma sistemlerinin değiştirilmesine yönelik başvuruların 2 Kasım 2026’dan itibaren yeniden başlaması planlanıyor. Termal bina yenileme destekleri ise 4 Ocak 2027’de başlayacak. Toplam 500 milyon Euro ayrıldı Program için ayrılan 500 milyon Euro’nun: 321 milyon Euro’su termal bina yenilemel

candidateAudit.text: Avusturya’da son seçim anketi: FPÖ yüzde 40’a ulaştı, üç hükümet partisini geride bıraktı Avusturya’da 11 Ekim 2026 tarihinde yayımlanan iki yeni seçim anketi, siyasi partiler arasındaki dengelere ilişkin dikkat çekici sonuçlar ortaya koydu. Herbert Kickl liderliğindeki FPÖ, anketlerde ilk sıradaki yerini korurken, araştırmalardan birinde yüzde 40’a ulaşarak üç hükümet partisinin toplam oy oranını geride bıraktı. FPÖ yüzde 40, hükümet ortakları toplam yüzde 39 Kronen Zeitung için IFDD araştırma şirketinin gerçekleştirdiği ankette partilerin oy oranları şöyle ölçüldü: FPÖ: Yüzde 40 ÖVP: Yüzde 19 Yeşiller: Yüzde 14 SPÖ: Yüzde 13 NEOS: Yüzde 7 KPÖ: Yüzde 5 Bu sonuçlara göre Başbakan Christian Stocker liderliğindeki ÖVP, SPÖ ve NEOS koalisyonunun toplam oy oranı yüzde 39'da kalıyor. Ankette dikkat çeken bir başka gelişme ise Yeşillerin yüzde 14 ile SPÖ'nün önüne geçmesi oldu. KPÖ'nün yüzde 5'e ulaşması da partinin seçim barajını aşabileceğine işaret ediyor. İkinci ankette FPÖ yüzde 37 Heute gazetesi için Unique Research tarafından yapılan diğer araştırmada ise FPÖ'nün oy oranı yüzde 37 olarak ölçüldü. Bu ankette ÖVP yüzde 20, SPÖ yüzde 17, Yeşiller yüzde 12 ve NEOS yüzde 9 seviyesinde bulunuyor. Böylece iki araştırma da FPÖ'nün ilk sırada olduğunu gösterirken, özellikle SPÖ'nün oy oranlarında araştırmalar arasında farklılıklar dikkat çekiyor. SPÖ'deki yönetim değişikliği gündemde SPÖ'de son günlerde yaşanan yönetim tartışmaları ve parti içindeki yeniden yapılanma süreci, Avusturya siyasetinin önemli gündem maddelerinden biri olmaya devam ediyor. candidateAudit.title: Viyana’da öğretmen açığı hafifledi ancak sorun bitmedi: Çok sayıda öğretmen yarı zamanlı çalışıyor Viyana’daki zorunlu eğitim okullarında yıllardır gündemde olan öğretmen sıkıntısı
candidateAudit.text: Viyana’da öğretmen açığı hafifledi ancak sorun bitmedi: Çok sayıda öğretmen yarı zamanlı çalışıyor Viyana’daki zorunlu eğitim okullarında yıllardır gündemde olan öğretmen sıkıntısında bu eğitim yılında bir miktar rahatlama yaşandı. Ancak sendika temsilcilerine göre personel sorunu tamamen çözülmüş değil. Özellikle çok sayıda öğretmenin yarı zamanlı çalışması okullardaki en önemli sorunlardan biri olmaya devam ediyor. Viyana Eğitim Müdürlüğü’nün verilerine göre kentte şu anda yaklaşık 18 bin öğretmen görev yapıyor. Öğretmen sendikası temsilcileri, bu yıl eğitim döneminin önceki yıllara kıyasla daha rahat başladığını belirtiyor. Ancak öğretmenlerin önemli bir bölümünün henüz üniversite eğitimine devam ettiği ve bu nedenle yalnızca yarı zamanlı çalışabildiği ifade ediliyor. Sendika temsilcisi Karin Medits-Steiner, öğretmenlik eğitimi devam ederken okullarda görev yapan çok sayıda kişinin bulunduğunu ve bunların önemli bölümünün part-time çalıştığını belirtti. Öğretmen sayısı tek başına yeterli değil Sendikanın diğer kanadından Thomas Krebs ise yalnızca toplam öğretmen sayısına bakmanın yeterli olmadığını savunuyor. Krebs’e göre öğretmenlerin hangi görevleri üstlenebildiği ve ne ölçüde kullanılabildiği de dikkate alınmalı. Özellikle üniversite eğitiminin yanında öğretmenlik yapan kişilerin, tam zamanlı bir öğretmenin üstlendiği tüm okul sorumluluklarını yerine getirmesi mümkün olmayabiliyor. 440 başvurudan 60 kişi işe alındı Öğretmen ihtiyacını karşılamak amacıyla meslek dışından öğretmenliğe geçiş programından da yararlanılıyor. Son başvuru döneminde 440 nitelikli başvuru yapı

candidateAudit.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan’dan yurt dışındaki Türklere mesaj: “Sizi kimsenin insafına bırakmayacağız” Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, 10 Ekim 2026 tarihinde Almanya’nın Neuss kentin
candidateAudit.text: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan’dan yurt dışındaki Türklere mesaj: “Sizi kimsenin insafına bırakmayacağız” Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, 10 Ekim 2026 tarihinde Almanya’nın Neuss kentinde düzenlenen Uluslararası Demokratlar Birliği’nin (UID) 9. Olağan Genel Kurulu’na gönderdiği video mesajda, yurt dışında yaşayan Türk vatandaşlarına seslendi. Avrupa başta olmak üzere dünyanın farklı ülkelerinde yaşayan ve başarılarıyla Türkiye’yi gururlandıran vatandaşlara selamlarını ileten Erdoğan, 7 milyonu aşkın Türk diasporasının önemine dikkat çekti. Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, konuşmasında şu ifadeleri kullandı: “Yurt dışında yaşayan siz kardeşlerimizi ne dışarıdaki yabancı düşmanı akımların ne de vatandaşlarımıza -affedersiniz- ‘zırzop’ diyerek aşağılayan ahlak yoksunu tiplerin insafına asla bırakmayacağız.” Erdoğan, yurt dışındaki Türklerin kimliklerini ve kültürlerini koruyarak yaşadıkları toplumlara katkı sağlamalarının önemini vurguladı. Kültürel ırkçılık, İslam düşmanlığı ve yabancı karşıtlığıyla mücadeleye de değinen Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, bu alanlarda faaliyet gösteren Uluslararası Demokratlar Birliği’nin çalışmalarını takdir etti. Türkiye’nin yurt dışındaki vatandaşlarına yönelik desteğinin devam edeceğini belirten Erdoğan, ilgili kurum ve kuruluşlar aracılığıyla vatandaşların yanında olmayı sürdüreceklerini ifade etti. Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, mesajını UID’nin 9. Olağan Genel Kurulu’nun başarılı geçmesi temennisiyle tamamladı.

candidateAudit.text: 🚨 Über 3 Stunden zu spät gelandet: KM 514 Malta → Wien kam heute (10.10.) laut Flugdaten erst um ca. 14:45 statt 11:35 Uhr in Wien-Schwechat an – rund +3:09 h. ✈️ Warst du an Bord? Dann merk dir diese 3 Punkte aus der EU-Fluggastrechte-Verordnung 261/2004: 👇 1️⃣ ENTSCHÄDIGUNG: Ab 3 Stunden Verspätung bei der Ankunft am Endziel sind je nach Distanz 250 €, 400 € oder 600 € pro Person möglich – für Malta–Wien (1.373 km) also bis zu 250 € pro Person. Ausnahme: außergewöhnliche Umstände – und die muss die AIRLINE beweisen, nicht du! 💪 2️⃣ ES ZÄHLT DIE ANKUNFT, NICHT DER ABFLUG: Maßgeblich ist, wann sich die Flugzeugtür am Endziel öffnet (EuGH). Und: Der Ticketpreis ist egal – die Pauschale gibt's pro Person, auch beim Schnäppchen-Tarif. Auszahlung in Geld; ein Gutschein nur, wenn du ausdrücklich zustimmst. 3️⃣ BETREUUNG: Schon ab 2 Stunden Wartezeit (Kurzstrecke) zahlt die Airline Essen & Getränke, bei Übernachtung Hotel + Transfer und 2 Telefonate/E-Mails. Ninja-Tipp: Alle Belege aufheben! 🧾 Wichtig: Die Entschädigung gibt's ZUSÄTZLICH zu Betreuungsleistungen – das eine schließt das andere nicht aus. 🥷 👉 Betroffen? Prüf deinen Anspruch kostenlos in 2 Minuten auf flugninja.at – 100 % risikofrei, keine Vorkosten. Hol dir, was dir zusteht! Hinweis: Allgemeine Information, keine Rechtsberatung im Einzelfall. Der Grund der Verspätung ist derzeit nicht bestätigt; bei außergewöhnlichen Umständen kann der Anspruch entfallen. Flugdaten laut unabhängigen Flugtrackern (Stand 10.10.2026, 18 Uhr). Grafiken und Text mit KI erstellt. #fluggastrechte #flugverspätung #entschädigung #eu261

candidateAudit.text: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphor. — on till 5 Nov 2026 Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 The exhibition emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Next guided tours: 15 Oct, 16:00–18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 21 Oct, 16:00—18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 5 Nov 12:00—13:00 Guided Tour 13:15—15:30 Workshop with Franziska Allerberger Out of Balance: On the Quest for Reconnecting (Register via this link) Photos: Hannah Mayr _hannahmayr_ The project 03: Soil is generously supported by ÖAW. oeaw.at

candidateAudit.text: There’s no single way we want coffee at Loka to taste. Sometimes we’re looking for balance and sweetness. Sometimes for bright fruit and acidity. And sometimes for something a little more unexpected. That’s why we currently work with three specialty roasters — thebarnberlin, kaffeelix.roastery and dakcoffeeroasters — each bringing a very different character to our coffee bar. From smooth, chocolatey espresso to bright, fruit-driven coffees and more playful, unexpected flavour profiles — together they give us room to explore just how different coffee can taste. Swipe through to meet the three roasters behind our coffee — and what we love about each of them 🤍 THE BARN · BERLIN A pioneer of European specialty coffee, THE BARN is known for beautifully roasted coffees with a naturally sweet, smooth character. At Loka, it’s our choice for a more classic espresso profile — think chocolate, nuts, balance and sweetness. KAFFEELIX · ST. PÖLTEN World-class roasting, close to home. Led by World Coffee Roasting Champion Felix Teiretzbacher, KAFFELIX brings a brighter side of coffee to our bar — lively acidity, beautiful fruit notes and plenty of character. DAK · AMSTERDAM DAK takes specialty coffee beyond the expected, combining light roasting with playful processing and complex, fruit-driven flavour profiles. The one to try when you’re curious to discover just how surprising coffee can be.

candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). candidateAudit.text: Gutes Brot braucht Zeit! Für viele Brotrezepte sind daher Vorstufen zum Backen notwendig, die für bessere Backeigenschaften, längere Frischhaltung und mehr Aromen sorgen. Das Brühstück ist eine solche Vorstufe beim Brotbacken, bei der Mehl, Schrot, Flocken oder Saaten mit kochendem oder sehr heißem Wasser vermischt und mindestens 2 bis 12 Stunden quellen gelassen. Hier zeigen wir euch, wie ihr ein Körnerbrühstück einfach selbst zubereiten könnt! Körnerbrühstück: 25 g Roggenvollkornmehl 25 g Haferflocken 50 g Sesam 50 g Sonnenblumenkerne 50 g Leinsamen 5 g Brotgewürz 260 g Wasser, kochend Alle trockenen Zutaten in eine Schüssel geben und verrühren. Die gleichmäßig vermischte Menge mit dem kochendem Wasser überbrühen, das Brühstück in der Schüssel abgedeckt mind. 3 Stunden abkühlen lassen. #krusteundkrume #backrezepte #bakinglove #brotbacken #brotbackenmachtglücklich

candidateAudit.title: Why doesn’t all coffee taste like… coffee? If you’ve ever had a cup that tasted surprisingly fruity, floral, chocolatey or sweet, there’s a reason for it. Where coffee is grown, ho
candidateAudit.text: Why doesn’t all coffee taste like… coffee? If you’ve ever had a cup that tasted surprisingly fruity, floral, chocolatey or sweet, there’s a reason for it. Where coffee is grown, how it’s processed, roasted and finally brewed — all of these things shape what eventually ends up in your cup. This idea is at the heart of third-wave coffee: treating coffee less like a commodity and more like a product with its own origin, character and flavour. It brought more attention to where coffee comes from, single-origin beans, careful brewing and lighter roasting — allowing the natural fruity, floral and other distinctive notes of the beans to come through rather than being dominated by the roast itself. It’s also what shapes the coffee we choose at Loka. We work with specialty roasters and look for coffees with a distinct origin and character — coffees that have something of their own to say in the cup. Over the next few weeks, our Coffee Series will take a closer look at the roasters we work with, the coffees on our bar, and the different ways to brew and experience them. Because good coffee should taste like where it came from — not just like coffee 🤍

candidateAudit.text: One of the highlights of Tatiana Koshkarova’s upcoming visit to Loka will be a workshop dedicated entirely to the art of hands-on assisting. A thoughtful hands-on assist is not simply about taking a practitioner deeper into a pose. Offered with knowledge, sensitivity and clear intention, it can create greater stability or space, help someone experience an asana differently, and deepen their understanding of the practice. Hands-on assisting is one of the defining features of the Jivamukti Yoga method — and one of the areas Tatiana Koshkarova is particularly known for within the Jivamukti community. Her approach is rooted in years of practice, teaching and teacher education. During this 3-hour workshop, Tatiana will share this accumulated experience through clear explanations and demonstrations, different approaches to assisting, and plenty of hands-on practice in pairs. The workshop is especially relevant for yoga teachers and those preparing for teacher training, but is equally open to dedicated practitioners who want to deepen their understanding of assisting and asana. 📌 The Art of Assisting with tatianakoshkarova October 10 • 13:00–16:00 Booking via Eversports — link in bio 🤍

candidateAudit.text: We keep on digging and the next artistic research exhibition will open in October – Save the date and join us! Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. candidateAudit.text: ✨ SAVE THE DATE: 7–11 October 2026 ✨ This October, we’re excited to welcome a special guest teacher to Loka — tatianakoshkarova, an 800-hour certified Advanced Jivamukti Yoga Teacher with extensive experience teaching classes, workshops and continuing education for yoga teachers around the world (Barcelona, Paris, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon and Dubai). candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.title: Wir finden es super, aus einem Teig gleich mehrere Backwerke zaubern zu können - so wie diese wunderbaren Mohn-Bagel, geformt aus unserem Kornspitz-Teig! Rezept KÖRNERBRÜHSTÜCK 25
candidateAudit.text: Wir finden es super, aus einem Teig gleich mehrere Backwerke zaubern zu können - so wie diese wunderbaren Mohn-Bagel, geformt aus unserem Kornspitz-Teig! Rezept KÖRNERBRÜHSTÜCK 25 g Roggenvollkornmehl 25 g Haferflocken 50 g Sesam 50 g Sonnenblumenkerne 50 g Leinsamen 5 g Brotgewürz 260 g Wasser, kochend HAUPTTEIG abgekühltes Brühstück 30 g Altbrot 190 g Wasser (20 °C) 480 g Weizenmehl 700 20 g Backhefe 20 g Honig 13 g Salz 8 g Roggenmalz 8 g Rapsöl 1. Körnerbrühstück: Alle trockenen Zutaten in eine Schüssel geben und verrühren. Die gleichmäßig vermischte Menge mit dem kochendem Wasser überbrühen, das Brühstück in der Schüssel abgedeckt mind. 3 Stunden abkühlen lassen. 2. Hauptteig: Das Altbrot in der Schüttflüssigkeit für 15 Minuten einweichen, pürieren und mit allen anderen Zutaten in eine Knetschüssel geben. Dann 10 Minuten langsam mischen, Salz hinzufügen und weitere 2-4 Minuten etwas schneller kneten, bis er eine geschmeidige Oberfläche aufweist und sich vom Schüsselrand löst. Die ideale Teigtemperatur nach dem Mischen beträgt 25-28°C. Den fertigen Teig in einer Schüssel zugedeckt 30 Minuten rasten lassen. 3. Aufarbeitung: Den leicht bemehlten Teig und auf eine saubere Arbeitsfläche stürzen, in 80 g schwere Stücke teilen und rundschleifen. Die geschliﬀenen Teiglinge mit einem Tuch zudecken und ca.25-30 Minuten entspannen lassen. Dann mit einem leicht bemehlten Rollholz ein Loch formen und dieses händisch noch ein wenig ausdehnen. Anschließend die Bagel auf einem feuchten Geschirrtuch anfeuchten, mit Mohn bestreuen und 30 Minuten zur Stückgare stellen. 4. Backen: Bei 235

candidateAudit.text: 🍂 MYTHOS ODER WAHRHEIT? Brauche ich im Herbst wirklich noch Sonnenschutz? Viele denken: Sobald der Sommer vorbei ist, kann die Sonnencreme wieder im Schrank bleiben. ☀️ Aber das stimmt so nicht. Auch im Herbst ist unsere Haut weiterhin UV-Strahlung ausgesetzt – deshalb gehört Sonnenschutz auch in der kühleren Jahreszeit zu einer guten Hautpflegeroutine. Besonders wichtig ist das, wenn du im Herbst Peelings, Säure-Behandlungen, Microneedling oder IPL machen lässt. Nach bestimmten Behandlungen kann die Haut empfindlicher gegenüber UV-Strahlung sein. 🤍 Unser Tipp: Lass dich bei YASUMI individuell beraten und erfahre, welche Pflege und welche Behandlung zu deiner Haut passt. #kosmetikWien #kosmetikstudioWien #hautpflegeWien

candidateAudit.text: 🚨 Wien ⇄ Berlin gleich doppelt gestrichen: OS 231 (Wien → Berlin, 15:00 Uhr) und OS 232 (Berlin → Wien, 16:55 Uhr) wurden heute annulliert! Der Grund ist bislang unbestätigt – geplant waren beide Flüge mit einem airBaltic-A220 im Wet-Lease für Austrian (OS 232 läuft auch als BT 232). Warst du betroffen – oder trifft es dich beim nächsten Mal? Dann merk dir diese 3 Ansprüche nach der EU-Fluggastrechte-Verordnung 261/2004: 👇 1️⃣ ENTSCHÄDIGUNG: Bei Annullierung sind je nach Flugdistanz 250 €, 400 € oder 600 € pro Person möglich – für Wien–Berlin (521 km) also bis zu 250 € pro Person. Ausnahmen (z. B. außergewöhnliche Umstände, Info mehr als 14 Tage vor Abflug oder eine zeitnahe Umbuchung) muss die AIRLINE beweisen, nicht du. 💪 2️⃣ ERSATZFLUG ODER GELD ZURÜCK: Du hast die Wahl – volle Ticket-Erstattung binnen 7 Tagen ODER schnellstmögliche Ersatzbeförderung, notfalls auch mit einer anderen Airline oder der Bahn. Bietet dir die Airline nichts Brauchbares an, darfst du selbst buchen und dir die Kosten zurückholen (OGH 1 Ob 133/18t). ✈️ 3️⃣ BETREUUNG: Während du wartest, zahlt die Airline Essen & Getränke, bei Übernachtung Hotel + Transfer und 2 Telefonate/E-Mails. Ninja-Tipp: Alle Belege aufheben! 🧾 Wichtig: Die Entschädigung aus Punkt 1 bekommst du ZUSÄTZLICH zu Ersatzflug/Erstattung – das eine schließt das andere nicht aus. 🥷 👉 Betroffen? Prüf deinen Anspruch kostenlos in 2 Minuten auf flugninja.at – 100 % risikofrei, keine Vorkosten. Hol dir, was dir zusteht! Hinweis: Allgemeine Information, keine Rechtsberatung im Einzelfall. candidateAudit.text: Wenn der Duft von frisch gebackenem Striezel durchs Haus zieht, werden in vielen Menschen Kindheitserinnerungen wach. Der Striezel ist untrennbar mit der österreichischen Backtradition verbunden und durfte einst auf keinem sonntäglichen Frühstückstisch fehlen. Wir zeigen euch ein schnelles, einfaches Rezept dazu. Egal wie viele Stränge euer Striezel hat, schmecken wird er mit diesem Rezept garantiert! Und wer sich intensiv mit dem Germteig auseinandersetzen möchte, kann das in unserem “Flaumige Striezel aus Germteig” Backkurs machen. Freie Plätze für unseren nächsten Termin sind noch verfügbar! Alle Infos dazu gibt es auf unserer Website. Viel Spaß beim Backen! Der Teig sollte sich vom Schüsselrand lösen. Beim Mischen mit der Küchenmaschine darauf achten, den Teig nicht zu überkneten. Die ideale Teigtemperatur nach dem Kneten beträgt 28 °C. Den Teig dann für 45 Minuten bei Raumtemperatur mit einem Tuch abgedeckt ruhen lassen. Während der Teigruhe darauf achten, dass der Teig nicht zu sehr auskühlt. candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.title: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo
candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. This month, we’ve been holding on to the simple things: evenings by the water, something cold to drink, music that makes you want to stay outside a little longer — and a few words and conversations that stayed with us. Here are a few things we’ve genuinely loved lately, from our most-reached-for summer drink to a podcast about hope, stamina and giving ourselves a little more grace. A little collection of August favourites, shared in the spirit of everyday wellbeing. What made your list this month? 🤍

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed way to spend your Saturday evening? Join us for (board) Gayme Night at Villa Vida Café, an evening of games, queer community, and meeting people. 📅 Saturday, 5 September ⏰ 18:00–late 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna Whether you’re a board game enthusiast, an occasional player, or have absolutely no idea what you’re doing, you’re welcome. 🃏♟️🎲 Come by yourself, with a friend, with a partner, or with a whole group. Arriving alone is completely normal—you can join a table and meet people through playing rather than having to make endless small talk. 🌈 What to expect: ✨ Board and card games ✨ Beginner-friendly atmosphere ✨ Queer community & new faces ✨ No need to be competitive ✨ Stay for one game or the whole evening ✨ Bring a favourite game if you want — or simply show up 🌍 Languages: We’re a multilingual community. English and German are commonly spoken, but there’s no required event language. Tables can play in whatever language works for everyone involved. ♿ Accessibility: Villa Vida Café has step-free access and an accessible toilet. The café is non-smoking indoors. Please keep in mind that several games and conversations may happen at once, so the space can become lively and noisy.

candidateAudit.title: Meet the teacher // Malcolm Malcolm first found yoga while living in New York City, when a friend invited him to a class. What began as curiosity quickly became a meaningful practi
candidateAudit.text: Meet the teacher // Malcolm Malcolm first found yoga while living in New York City, when a friend invited him to a class. What began as curiosity quickly became a meaningful practice — and eventually a calling to teach, share yoga, and create space for others to reconnect with themselves and their own vitality. His teaching blends Power Vinyasa, Yoga Sculpt, and Somatic Flow. Malcolm loves building strength and heat while keeping awareness, presence, and connection to the body at the heart of the practice. His classes are energetic and powerful, but there is always something deeply human running through them. Music is a big part of Malcolm’s teaching — and if you’ve practiced with him, you might already know that he also has an incredible voice and sings during class. Add to that the fact that he is an absolute sunshine of a human being, and this is one of those experiences we really think you should come and feel for yourself. At Loka, Malcolm currently teaches Power Flow — and from September, he’ll be introducing Sculpt Flow, his signature format and a new concept for Vienna, bringing together the elements that define his teaching: powerful movement, sculpt-inspired strength work, flow, and deep connection to the body.

What Is Day DJ at Villa Vida? Day DJ at Villa Vida Café is a regular series that gives local DJs space to share their sound in a daytime setting. The series focuses on new talent, experimentation, and community. Rather than putting DJs exclusively into a late-night club environment, Day DJ creates an accessible daytime space where artists can build sets, explore ideas, and connect with an audience. candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. This edition of the Sapphic Film Series is hosted and curated by ni.pi_art 📅 Thursday, 20 August 2026 🕖 19:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ Free entry – no registration necessary 🌈 Who’s welcome? Everyone who wants to engage respectfully with sapphic and queer cinema. The series centres sapphic stories and experiences, but you do not need to identify as sapphic or queer to attend. Friends and allies are welcome too. ♿ Accessibility Villa Vida Café has a ramp at the Linke Wienzeile entrance and an accessible toilet on the ground floor. Seating is available for the screening, and the indoor café is non-smoking. candidateAudit.title: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to conne
candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. QVMAF provides emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna facing unexpected financial hardship. Learn more or support the fund at queervienna.at

candidateAudit.text: Some months invite us to do more. Others gently remind us to slow down. For us, July was about small rituals, quiet moments and choosing kindness over self-criticism a little more often. Here are a few things we’ve genuinely loved this month — from a summer drink we’ve been making on repeat to a book that stayed with us, a song we kept coming back to, and one little ritual that never fails to end a practice on the right note. candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: Russende lernen zwei Dinge früh: leiden(Schaft ^^) und drei Akkorde. Nachts bei Mariahilf ein bisschen Kultur gemacht. Schön war’s! Danke liebe alessandradelato tneu „Gruppa Krowi na rukawe“ von Kino handelt von einem jungen Menschen, der zwischen einem ruhigen normalen Leben und dem Gefühl steht, kämpfen oder seinen Weg gehen zu müssen. Das Lied wirkt wie ein Soldatenlied, ist aber eher eine melancholische Reflexion über Pflicht, Angst, Identität und Freiheit. Die „Blutgruppe am Ärmel“ symbolisiert dabei, wie Menschen im Krieg oder im System zu Nummern werden.

candidateAudit.title: – mein weiteres Hobby – wütende Posts. Man spricht so viel darüber: TV, Öffentlichkeit, Internet… ändern tut sich gefühlt gar nichts. Auf allen Ebenen – zu Hause, am Arbeitsmarkt,
candidateAudit.text: – mein weiteres Hobby – wütende Posts. Man spricht so viel darüber: TV, Öffentlichkeit, Internet… ändern tut sich gefühlt gar nichts. Auf allen Ebenen – zu Hause, am Arbeitsmarkt, im (männlich basierten) Freundeskreis, in der Künstler… Ausgegrenzt zu werden. Nicht ernst genommen zu werden. Alles erklären zu müssen. Permanent. Wer nicht sehen/hören will, wird es nicht verstehen (wollen). Das kostet so viel Energie – die ich sowieso kaum habe. Oft denke ich: einfach lassen. Träume aufgeben. Weil ich eine Migra-Frau mit zwei Kindern ohne Vitamin B in Österreich bin. Nicht mehr kämpfen. Ich glaube, ich verstehe, warum #Tradewife wieder kommt. Nicht, weil wir wollen – sondern weil wir nicht mehr können. Weil Motivation, Anerkennung und Unterstützung strukturell fehlen. Dinge, die Männer gar nicht erst brauchen müssen. Weil es ihre Welt ist. Und wir sollen uns anpassen, um überhaupt einen Platz zu bekommen. Beim PartnER. Beim ArbeitgebER. Ich fühle mich allein – obwohl so viele dieselben Probleme haben. Ohne Männer, die sich aktiv einsetzen, kommen wir nicht weiter. Ich habe das Gefühl: ich komme nicht weiter.

candidateAudit.text: Ever wondered why drinking coffee at Das Lazy is extra special? candidateAudit.text: Luft und Liebe® Hochzeitsfestival in Wien 07.09.2025, 10:30-16:00 Uhr METAStadt Wien Am 7. September 2025 findet unsere Hochzeitsmesse der neuen Generation bereits zum 6. Mal in Wien statt. Wobei – Messe ist eigentlich das falsche Wort, denn bei uns gibts kein spießiges Oldschool-Messe-Gedöns wie rote Teppiche oder hässliche Werbebanner, und wir bitten Sie um Verständnis, dass Sie womöglich geduzt werden könnten. candidateAudit.text: thisispattismith Lyrikerin, Musikerin, Fotografin und Malerin – seit ihren künstlerischen Anfängen in den 1970er Jahren begeistert Patti Smith über Generationen hinweg. Ihre leidenschaftlichen und tiefgründigen Texte hat die Punk-Poetin unter anderem in ihren elf Studioalben verewigt. Songs wie ihre rebellische Version von "Gloria", "Because the Night" oder "People Have The Power" sind zu Klassikern geworden. 2015 feierte Patti Smith mit einer beeindruckenden Tour das 40-jährige Bestehen ihres Albums "Horses". Ende Oktober 2019 bekam die "Godmother of Punk" in Wien das Ehrenzeichens der Republik Österreich für Wissenschaft und Kunst verliehen. 2024 beehrt sie uns wieder und zwar bei uns in der METAStadt – Große Freude 😊 ❗Tickets gibt’s bei oeticket metastadtopenairs
